text: Gifted Heal is a ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Gilnean Workers are worgen and humans located in Gilneas City.
Gilnean Children are humans located in Greymane Court in Gilneas City.
Gilnean Shopkeepers are humans and worgen located in Merchant Square in Gilneas City.
Gillsbane drops from Defias mobs in Moonbrook and the Dagger Hills in . Attacking murlocs in Westfall with it has a chance to make them drop Soul of the Sea (Season of Discovery).
Gilnean Workhorses are a pair of horses located near Fenegan Cobbler in Greymane Court in Gilneas City in the Ruins of Gilneas.
Gilnean Citizens are humans and worgen located in Gilneas City and the other settlements in the Ruins of Gilneas.

Gilded of the Undermine is a feat of strength earned by outgrowing the use of the Gilded Undermine Crest during The War Within Season 2. This requires reaching an item level of 675 or higher in all equipment slots. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade.GetHighWatermarkForSlot(i); if a Upon earning the achievement, Vaskarn sends players the following in-game mail attached with a Crimson Valorstone, containing 100 Valorstones.

Gilded Vial is a crafting reagent used in Khaz Algar Alchemy. It can be bought from vendors or made by players with Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting. The ability to make this item can be learned from Makir in Dornogal for once the player has reached a skill level of 15 in Khaz Algar Jewelcrafting.

Gilded of the Ethereal is a feat of strength earned by obtaining an average item level of 160 (was 720) during The War Within Season 3. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade.GetHighWatermarkForSlot(i); if a Upon earning the achievement, Vaskarn sends players the following in-game mail attached with a Crimson Valorstone, containing 100 Valorstones.

Ginger-Glazed Fillet is a food item made with Khaz Algar Cooking (25). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.
Gilded Silvermoon Candelabra is housing decor that can be purchased for from Jehzar Starfall in Razorwind Shores or Balen Starfinder in Founder's Point.
The Gladiataur is a tauren located in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar.
Glade Prowl is an ability used by a pet during a Pet Battle.
Glacial Tomb is an ability card from the Throne of the Tides set.
Glacial Strike is an ability card from the Twilight of the Dragons set.
The Gleaming Moonbeast is an umbraclaw mount that was part of the 2024 12-Month Subscription Bundle.
Glasses of Wine are located on the beach at Southfury River in the Northern Barrens and at Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City during Love is in the Air.

Gladiator: The War Within Season 1 is a feat of strength earned by winning 50 3v3 arena matches while at Elite rank during The War Within Season 1. This achievement gives the following rewards: *Gladiator title for the duration of The War Within Season 1 *Forged Gladiator's Fel Bat mount

Gladiator: The War Within Season 2 is a feat of strength earned by winning 50 3v3 arena matches while at Elite rank during The War Within Season 2. This achievement gives the following rewards: *Gladiator title for the duration of The War Within Season 2 *Prized Gladiator's Fel Bat mount

Gladiator: Midnight Season 1 is a feat of strength earned by winning 50 3v3 games while at Elite rank during Midnight Season 1.

The achievement is automatically rewarded to those that had qualified during . This achievement replaces the original Gladiator (achievement) achievement for Classic.

Glimmering Shore is a gorloc-infested shoreline on the southern end of the Isle of Dorn. Dhar Durgaz is halfway up the mountain to the northwest, with Freywold Village further northwest, Boskroot Basin to the northeast, and Wanderer's Landing to the east. It is home to the Pearlfin gorlocs and earthen pearl farmers.
Glittering Gemeye is a butterfly located in Stoneshaper's Atrium on the Isle of Dorn. Iggraya is trying to catch it.
Glitterpool Frog are frogs found near Suramar City in Suramar.
Glop is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Glory of the Midnight Raider is a meta raid achievement earned by completing a series of raid achievements in the three launch raids of : Voidspire, Dreamrift, and March on Quel'Danas. It rewards the Tenebrous Harrower flying mount.

Gloomshade Blossoms are lashers found inside Mad "King" Sporeon's cave at the Gloomshade Grove in Shadowmoon Valley. They are uninteractable at first, and mostly buried with the exception of their heads, but will pop up and attack when stood on. They drop no loot.

Gloaming Alloy is a bar crafting reagent made with and used extensively in Midnight Blacksmithing. The ability to make this item can be learned from Bemarrin, Chrysalius, and Arathel Sunforge for once the blacksmith's skill in Midnight Blacksmithing has reached 15.
Glimmerfly Darters are glimmerflies found just south of Hero's Rest in Bastion.
Glimmerfly Dusters are glimmerflies found just northwest of Hero's Rest in Bastion.
Glimmerfly Flutterers are glimmerflies found just northeast of the Temple of Courage in Bastion.
Glimmering Illusions are glimmerfly projections summoned by Giant Glimmerflies at the Firstborne's Bounty in Bastion.
Glory to the Alliance! is an ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Glowing Deepshards are geodes found in the Deep Roads and the Darkbrul Arena in Highmountain. They light up their immediate surroundings while they are alive.
Glyph of Arcane Familiar is sold by Libergo in Valdrakken or Charys Yserian at Ancient Curios in Stormwind City for .
Glyph of Discreet Magic is a minor glyph for mages that never went live.
.]] Glowmites are a type of firefly found primarily in underground areas such as the Ringing Deeps, Hallowfall, Azj-Kahet, and Harandar.
Glyph of Shifting Power is sold by Liawyn in Oribos or Aithlyn at the Heart of the Forest in Ardenweald for .

Glyph of the Sentinel is a druid glyph that changes the druid's flying Travel Form into an owl. Night elves in sentinel form are blue and gold; worgen are purple; trolls are pale gray; and tauren are brown. This glyph can only be applied if the druid is trained up to at least Artisan Riding.
Gnomelia Gearheart is a gnome companion given to players who complete the tutorial and defeat in Warcraft Rumble. Obtaining this pet rewards the "S.A.F.E" Pilot feat of strength.
Glyph of the Spectral Lupine is created with Shadowlands Inscription (100); taught by Technique: Glyph of the Spectral Lupine. It alters the default appearance of the Shaman ability Ghost Wolf.
Gnoll Battle Plan is found in the gnoll camp in the Three Corners in the Redridge Mountains.
The Glyphataur is a tauren located in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar. He reuses the ID of the Flaskataur, Esq.

Gnoll Way begins the Catch Up Experience, accessed through the Adventure Guide's Tutorials tab. Starting the experience will have the player teleport to just outside Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands.

]] The gnarldin are a race of giants found in Zul'Aman, primarily around Bitterbark and Akil'zon's Reach. They are not originally from Zul'Aman, and came from elsewhere. A fierce, nomadic people, they normally keep to themselves and dwell in the forest caves to the north, but they have recently been pushed into Amani territory by the Twilight's Blade. Gnarldin collect various items as trophies, which they see as proof of strength. As a form of trial, some prospective Amani warriors travel to Bitterbark to claim trophies from the gnarldin. Not all are successful. Within the Maisara Caverns, the spirits of Restless Gnarldin are among the undead guardians raised by the Vilebranch tribe.
Gnomish Tesla Coil is housing decor rewarded by the quest Spare A Chair. Additional copies can be purchased for from Second Chair Pawdo in Stormwind City, Orgrimmar, and Dornogal.
The Goblin Tome can be found next to Gazlowe in Ratchet in the . It contains Baxtan: On Destructive Magics.
Goblin Boxer's Wraps are available for from Smaks Topskimmer at the Incontinental Hotel after reaching renown 14 with the Cartels of Undermine.
Gnomish Steam-Powered Bed is housing decor created with Classic Engineering (240). The recipe is taught by trainers.
The Golden Discus is a flying disc mount that can be purchased for 2,200 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) from Hemet Nesingwary XVII at the Infinite Bazaar during Pandaria Remix.
Gold Balloons are summoned by Isaandrae outside the Caverns of Time in Tanaris. They can be hopped on to fly around the area.
Gold Rush is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Golden Ashened Cataclysm is a flying vendor mount that is available from Landro's Golden Loot Box. It is a gold-plated variant of the Ashened Cataclysm mount and is exclusively available on China realms. It is accompanied by Golden Sparkion, a reagent vendor and repairer; and Golden Emberia, a mail carrier.
Golden Boughs is an area found northeast of Western Sungrove, north of Dawnstar Village, and west of Sun's Reach Harbor on the Isle of Quel'Danas. It is full of wildlife.

Goldspine Plate is an 8-piece plate transmog set. It is a recolor of the Battlegear of Might that uses appearances originally obtained in , though entire set (including pieces that were never otherwise available) can be collected from Ensemble: Goldspine Plate. ;Head *Goldspine Helm *Faceguard of the Endless Watch (Doomwalker, Shadowmoon Valley) ;Shoulders *Goldspine Pauldrons *Ripfiend Shoulderplates (Doom Lord Kazzak, Hellfire Peninsula) ;Chest *Goldspine Breastplate ;Wrist *Goldspine Armplates *Amber Bands of the Aggressor (Warlord Kalithresh, Steamvault) ;Hands *Goldspine Fists *Topaz-Studded Battlegrips (Doom Lord Kazzak, Hellfire Peninsula) ;Waist *Goldspine Belt *Borak's Belt of Brave

Goldskin is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

Goliath Eggs are aqir eggs found surrounding the Titanus Egg at the Ruins of Ammon in Uldum during the Assault in Uldum when Titanus Egg (quest) is up. When these are destroyed, Goliath Hatchlings will spawn.
Gorging Mites are devourers located in the Destroyer's Breach in Castle Nathria.
Gorebound Stranglers drop from The Coaglamation in the City of Threads.
Gorged Cavelice are larvae found inside Rockcrawler Chasm in Highmountain.

Gorecrazed Maulers are bears found at Oakheart and just south of Moonrest in Val'sharah. Upon attacking them, they will sometimes change into a small haunt called Nightmare Horror. Upon killing the Horror, the corpse will change back to that of the bear. Upon taming them, they will lose their nightmare-corrupted skin effect.
Grace of the Machine is a power obtained from Kuldas' Toolbox during Awakening The Machine.

Gortham is a kapara pet rewarded from You Conduit!, a feat of strength in the Nexus-Point Xenas dungeon. Acquiring this pet is one of the secrets that counts for Mind-Seeker. To begin, with a full party of five level players, clear the trash leading up to Chief Corewright Kasreth in the Corespark Engineway. Then, all five players need to stand on the five Corespark Conduits simultaneously to dislodge something, popping out the kapara in a Netherstorm Structural Cage! Once the pet has been unlocked, other level players can zone in to the dungeon and loot the pet as well.
Gorm Egg Tenders are gorm flyers found at Gormhive in Ardenweald.
The Grand Walk is the first area in Castle Nathria. The Shriekwing, Huntsman Altimor Hungering Destroyer, and Sludgefist encounters occurs here.

The Grand Menagerie is an area located in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market. Within it, Xy'noc and Xy'nam are trying to sell Alcruux. During the war on K'aresh, the Grand Menagerie is being assaulted by Bakishiroth the Empowered after Trader Ba'kril's experimentation went awry. Adventurers are sent into the menagerie to slay the observer. Several other creatures can also be seen in cages, such as a proto-drake, Skeletal Lasher, and Raging Colossus.

Great Purple Dragon Turtles are dragon turtles located at the pandaren camps in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.
Great Blue Dragon Turtles are dragon turtles located at the pandaren camps in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.
Great Green Dragon Turtles are dragon turtles located at the pandaren camps in Orgrimmar and Stormwind City.

Greaseguard Acquisitioners are goblins located in Deadfin Mire on the Siren Isle while Tides of Greed is active. They have been charmed by the island's sirens and now fight for them. Regald Hornfyre asks adventurers to free them from the sirens' charm with a Sonic Scrambler prepared for them by their goblin allies. After being freed, they become friendly to the adventurer and cheer before running away.
Great Cleave is an ability used by various companions during a Pet Battle.
Greater Apocalypse is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.

The Great Devourer is a devourer located in delves as a Strange Disturbance during The War Within Season 3. Killing it will spawn a Hunger From Beyond that contains the Hunger from Beyond delve power.
Greatback Mushan are mushan found at the Thundering Run in the Dread Wastes. A dead one can also be found at the southern end of the Lake of Stars.
Greater Jungle Stalkers are tigers found in Island Expeditions.

Greater Verdant Crest of Honor was an optional crafting reagent used by Dragon Isles professions to craft unique profession item level 476 PvP gear during Dragonflight Season 3. They could be bought from Seltherex in the Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken for .

Greater Verdant Trophy of Conquest was an optional crafting reagent used by Dragon Isles professions to craft unique profession item level 489 PvP gear during Dragonflight Season 3. They could be be obtained from the quest Alerting all Adversaries! or they could be bought from Calderax in the Gladiator's Refuge in Valdrakken for .
Greater Rune of Infinite Stars is available from Augermu in Dornogal as part of Horrific Visions Revisited for 1,000 Displaced Corrupted Mementos after completing Enhancing Corruption.
Greater Rune of Twilight Devastation is available from Augermu in Dornogal as part of Horrific Visions Revisited for 1,000 Displaced Corrupted Mementos after completing Enhancing Corruption.
Greaves of Shattered Space drop from Dimensius in Manaforge Omega.

Sir Gregory Edmunson, also known by his paladin name of Sage Truthbearer, is an undead death knight. Once a member of the Order of the Silver Hand, he was raised into undeath after he was killed by Arthas Menethil in Andorhal. Although he was freed from the control of the Lich King, Gregory still chose to serve him of his own free will, deeming that it was the only possible path to protect Azeroth from threats like the Burning Legion. During the events of , Gregory allied with his old friend Aeonas and the paladin adventurer to find and destroy the demonic Echoing Orbs. After the death of Aeonas and the defeat of Azgaloth, Gregory chose not to return to Northrend and left in search of others
Grimgull is a seagull flying north of Jetsam Drift on the Siren Isle.
Grimoire: Imp Lord is a Demonology warlock talent. It is used to gain access to Singe Magic while the Imp is not the active minion. It is an exclusive choice node with Grimoire: Fel Ravager.
Grimoire: Fel Ravager is a Demonology warlock talent. It is used to gain access to Devour Magic while the Felhunter is not the active minion. It is an exclusive choice node with Grimoire: Imp Lord.
Grimoire of Portal of Summoning teaches the Portal of Summoning ability for warlocks.
Grimoire of Soul Harvesting teaches the Soul Harvesting ability for warlocks.
Grips of the Earth drop from Kronolith, Might of the Mountain on the Isle of Dorn.

The Grisly Colossus is a Maldraxxi skeleton that is summoned by interacting with the Grisly Curio in the southern corner of Amarth's encounter area at the Fall of Courage in the Necrotic Wake. For Bountiful Harvest, it needs to be killed on Mythic difficulty and then Amarth has to use his Final Harvest ability on its corpse.
Grip of the Damned is an ability card from the Worldbreaker set.
Grit Alphadrill is a goblin located upstairs in the Incontinental Hotel during Liberation of Undermine. He serves as an item upgrader.

The ability to make this item can be learned from Kotag in Dornogal for once the tailor has reached skill level 40 in Khaz Algar Tailoring.
Gritshell Krolusks are krolusks located in the desert of the central island of K'aresh.
Grizzlefur Patriarchs are bears found in Island Expeditions.
Gritplate Crystaleyes are basilisks found in Island Expeditions.
Gritplate Basilisks are basilisks found in Island Expeditions.
Ground Current is a Mountain Thane hero talent for warriors.
Gruthit is a nerubian found in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Growl of Fortitude was a hunter pet ability taught by bear trainers during the beta.
Lonomia is a Highmountain tauren located at the Saltfang Shoals in Razorwind Shores.
Gruga Bloodblade is a jungle troll located in the Hall of the Brave in Orgrimmar. He serves the Darkspear Raiders as the battlemaster for the Darkspear Islands battleground.

Guardian's Endurance is an ability card from the Tomb of the Forgotten set.
Guided Buoyancy Accelerant is a quest reward from Beach Bot. It is provided to aid in accessing the South Seas islands for other quests in the chain.
Gulls are seagulls flying around the Flotsam Shoal and Jetsam Drift on the Siren Isle.
Guise of the Stalker is an ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Gwan'ro is a nerubian jewelcrafting trainer located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
Gut'usul is a nerubian found in the Sureki Command in the City of Threads.

HELP WANTED: Kaja'Curiosity begins the optional optional Kaja'Curiosity questline for Sojourner of Undermine. To be offered this quest from the Gig Sheets call board at the Incontinental Hotel in Undermine, players must have first completed chapter four of the Undermine(d) campaign in Sour Victory.

__NOTOC__ Gyrating Gear is an engineering crafting reagent part that is needed in many Engineering schematics in Khaz Algar Engineering. It is a discovery learned through the ability Scour Through Scrap, which requires the Inventing and the Scrapper specializations.

Guts is a bat located in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet during The Queen's Chains. Lilian Voss and the adventurer attempt to use it to escape from Xal'atath and Y'tekhi, it was wounded by the latter, forcing Lilian and the adventurer on the ground. After they defeated Y'tekhi, Guts is found perched in Tower of Tomes.
Hacking the Planet becomes available after reaching Renown 11 with Manaforge Vandals.

Hall of Fame: Fyrakk the Blazing is a guild feat of strength earned by being amongst the first two hundred guilds worldwide to defeat Fyrakk the Blazing in Amirdrassil, the Dream's Hope on Mythic difficulty. It rewards the Famed Slayer of Fyrakk title. Echo-Tarren Mill in the Europe region was the world‑first guild, completed on 26 November 2023, at 5:22 PM CST.

The Half-Buried Dog Bowl is located at on the Tranquil Strand on the Isle of Dorn, but only for players who have brought Dog to the Magical Menagerie in Legions version of Dalaran. After inspecting the bowl, Dog appears! : :
The Half-Buried Chest is found at Eastmoon Ruins in Tanaris during the Bronze Celebration. It is revealed with the Torch of Pyrreth and contains a Golden Chalice (Guest Relations).

Hakka is a stealthed pandaren found in the Shado-Pan Monastery. He is found kneeling in front of a gravestone on a slightly elevated area with a graveyard across the water to the right, just before the first bridge after exiting the Sha of Violence's room. Certain class abilities or profession items have to be used to get some extra height to reach this area, as the edges are steep.

The Hal'hadar Battery Core drops from Hal'hadar mobs during Void Assaults. It is made with ethereal technomancy, Argunite-powered Lightforged warframe components, and arcane-conductive spores. It begins Hal'hadar Battery Core (quest).

The Halls of the Chosen is the second area of the Eternal Palace, located in a central location deep underwater. It splits off into the Darkest Depths and the Font of Radiance, as the entities there guard the integrity of a magical barrier. It is here that players fought Ashvane.
Hammering Drill is an ability used by a pet during a Pet Battle.
Hallowfall Chili is a food item made with Khaz Algar Cooking (15). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.

Hands of the Quarter Moon were a quest reward from Prowlers of the Barrens.

Harmonic Music Stone can be created from a Condensed Arcane Magic and looted from a Primordial Spirit Cache and Primordial Music Cache.
__NOTOC__ Hardwrench Tour Balloon is a hot air balloon that briefly appears during High Priest Venoxis (Horde).

Harbinger of the Weathered is a feat of strength earned by outgrowing the use of the Weathered Harbinger Crest during The War Within Season 1. This requires reaching an item level of 593 or higher in all equipment slots. Once done, players can trade their Weathered crests up to Carved Harbinger Crests in a 6-to-1 ratio by speaking with Vaskarn. The macro below will display slots that are below the required item level: /run local n=tInvert(Enum.ItemRedundancySlot),a;for i=0,16 do a = C_ItemUpgrade.GetHighWatermarkForSlot(i); if a Upon earning the achievement, Vaskarn sends players the following in-game mail attached with a Crimson Valorstone, containing 100 Valorstones.

Harbinger of the Carved is a feat of strength earned by outgrowing the use of the Carved Harbinger Crest during The War Within Season 1. This requires reaching an item level of 606 or higher in all equipment slots. Once done, players can trade their Carved crests up to Runed Harbinger Crests in a 6-to-1 ratio by speaking with Vaskarn. Hardcore is a community-created playstyle in World of Warcraft: Classic that emphasizes permadeath and self-imposed survival challenges. Before Blizzard officially introduced Hardcore servers, players developed their own rules and systems to ensure authenticity, using third-party tools and community oversight. The Hardcore challenge emerged as a grassroots effort among players seeking a higher-stakes experience. Inspired by permadeath mechanics in other games, participants voluntarily enforced strict survival rules to add depth and difficulty to the game. Over time, dedicated communities formed, refining the guidelines and creating systems to verify Hardcore runs.
Hard Mode: Tazavesh, the Veiled Market is a feat of strength earned by defeating So'leah in Tazavesh, the Veiled Market on Hard Mode during The War Within Season 3.

Haranir Phial of Finesse is a phial made with Midnight Alchemy. The ability to make this item is learned after unlocking the Fluent in Flasks specialization and the Haranir Secrets subspecialization. It temporarily increases the imbiber's finesse and deftness.

Harpies are a flying unit of the Beast family in Warcraft Rumble. While their health is low, their damage is quite high, and they work well against melee units. A squad of harpies is made up of three members.

Harrison Bones is a skeleton located in the Trade District in Stormwind City, in Orgrimmar and in the Searing Basin. He provides loot from the Temple of Atal'Hakkar. He's likely named after Harrison Jones.

Harvester Farnee is an earthen located at Durgaz Cabin on the Isle of Dorn. Farnee is a tender to bees. During the war in Khaz Algar, Farnee came to Harmot at Durgaz Cabin to help her heal her ram Shalehoof, after it was injured by an earth elemental at her pond. She was also questioning him about when he would deal with the nearby sleeping mountain giant and the elementals that were bothering it. They used up all her fire honey on the wound, and she had ordered a parcel with medicine for Shalehoof's leg, but it got lost until an adventurer found it and delivered it to her. The Harvesting Hatchet is sold by Lestia Goldenstrike and Xiz'ro after completing Lumber For You and learning the Lumberjack (passive) passive. It teaches the Find Lumber tracking ability, allowing one to see and harvest lumber from trees.
Hatching Mirehunter Eggs are saurolisk eggs found just west of Zalamar in Nazmir. When one of these is destroyed, a Mirehunter Hatchling will spawn.

Harrowers are otherworldly flying aberrations found in the Voidstorm. The domanaar and the Devouring Host often use them as ariel support and vanguard assault beasts. They are brutal aerial predators known for their terrifying appearance and hunting prowess. Some of the fiercest harrowers of Predacea have been twisted by the Void and bound to Xal'atath's will.

Hateforged Blazecycle is a deathcycle mount that can be purchased at the Trading Post for 500 Trader's Tender. It was previously obtained from the Mountain Dew Gaming promotion by purchasing , , or products, which included codes that could be redeemed on the [https://www.mtndewgaming.com/ MTN Dew Gaming Program] website for points to redeem rewards such as this mount, which required 600 points.
